summaryDetail: The major push right now is the global marketing strategy refocus on Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting a plan and the team auditing conversion tracking and participant profiles; US partnership programs are on hold for Q1. This week, urgent attention is needed to fix Outlook account lockouts across all devices and to confirm backend account unlock with JSB. The knowledge website design is nearly settled: keep the current layout but incorporate Joseph's elements like more articles and indices, remove the videos panel, and bring in the BCI index banner; Joseph, Julie, and Joker need to meet to mark feedback and implement changes. Upcoming deadlines include sending content for the work report (Sep 14–Oct 30) to Ira, providing details on two news releases (Sun Tianshu's research and cities in China) to Joseph, and answering questions for the Custom Program page rewrite from Mara, Madi, and Xiao Rong.

Use the school menu at the top and consider centering the knowledge menu.
